lines.en: I push a ridge up through the soil.

lines.zh: 身下的沙沙响，一路跟着我。
lines.en: The hiss of sand follows me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地表游动，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I swim just below the surface, nearly unseen.
Clods of earth roll off my back.
I head toward the vibration.
Loose earth here. Easy going.
I go around a big stone.
The soil's thin. I press lower.
I stop under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 我朝沙地那边拐了个弯。
lines.en: I turn toward the sandy patch.
I push forward slowly.
The ground swells a little over me.

lines.zh: 我伏在土里，只露一截背。
lines.en: I lie in the soil with only my back showing.
I'm growing. Getting longer.
Not yet. Far from grown.
Vibration comes from above.
I can tell the smells in the soil.
I'm hungry. Not in a hurry.
This layer of soil is warm.
I poke my head out a little.

lines.zh: 有只虫子在旁边，太小了。
lines.en: A bug nearby. Too small.
I'm waiting for something bigger.
There's a lot of time. I have plenty.
I bury my head in the soil again.
It's close in the soil. I'm used to it.
I'm waiting for the next footfall.
You're standing on the earth above me.
I feel every step you take.

lines.zh: 我只有这么长，不够从下往上冲。
lines.en: I'm only this long. Not enough to strike from below.
Not long enough. So I wait.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我的须就碰到你。
lines.en: One step closer and my barbels touch you.
Half a step nearer will do.

lines.zh: 我的头在土里，你看不见。
lines.en: My head is in the soil. You can't see it.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: Your shadow falls. I know where you are.
The longer you stand, the hotter the sand below.

lines.zh: 我只露一条缝，看你的脚。
lines.en: I show only a slit, watching your feet.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来看土，我在下面。
lines.en: You crouch to look at the soil. I'm beneath.
You can't see a thing.
The soil collapsed and buried me.
I twist and burrow deeper.
That made me stop.
My back is exposed.
I pull in under the soil.
I can still move with this much.
It's quiet in the soil. I rest.
I'm not grown yet. I can't die.
A little further and I'm fine.
Don't step. I'm right below.
It isn't moving. I don't eat that.
What I want is something that moves.
If you put it down, it's dead too.
I want something that runs.
Too small to fill anything.
The bait you set down does not tempt me.

lines.zh: 那味道不对，我缩回土里。
lines.en: That smell is wrong; I sink back into the soil.
I prefer what's in the soil.
I dart through dirt, striking at your feet.
Put it down. Don't hold it up.
You caved the soil above me.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的脚，被踩了回来。
lines.en: I hit your foot and got stepped back down.

lines.zh: 土全塌了，我只好往深处钻。
lines.en: The soil collapsed. I go deeper.
I slide past your foot.
That exposed my back.
I burrow back down at once.
We collided and dirt sprayed.
Don't stand too long. The soil will give.
I shift fifteen feet sideways.
Now you can't step on me.
I'm not at that stage yet.
That comes after growing up.
When I'm grown, we'll talk about the rest.
Life in the soil is long.
Are you in this soil too?
I feel your vibration.
Light. Regular.
Light and steady. That's good.
Don't go far. Stay in this soil.

lines.zh: 这片土，我一个人也待得住。
lines.en: I can stay in this soil alone too.

lines.zh: 幼体只有十二点血，也顶。
lines.en: Twelve health as a juvenile, and I still shove.
Stones in the soil. I don't pick them up.
It was in my path.

lines.zh: 我用吻部把石块顶出洞口。
lines.en: I nudge the stone out of my burrow with my snout.
Two hours before I grow up.
I go around it.
Something's caught on my back.

lines.zh: 我甩动身体，把土块抖落。
lines.en: I shake my body and the clod falls off.
I've no use for what's in the soil.
Push through the soil. Onward.
Something's walking. Heavy.
I burrow that way.
The soil carries it clearly.
I can tell how far.
The soil's thin. Nearer still.

lines.zh: 我从土里探出半个脑袋。
lines.en: I poke half my head out of the soil.
The soil's thin. I can break out.
The thinnest spot. Right here.
I coil tight.
I get one try.
Coil tight, then burst out.

lines.zh: 我只有这一次，就这一下。
lines.en: One try. Just this one blow.
The soil moves. That's me.
I've picked the thinnest spot.
I follow that vibration.

lines.zh: 它一挪，我的头就跟着偏。
lines.en: It shifts, and my head follows.
The soil brings me the sound.
I pause to listen properly.
The vibration's close. It's near.

lines.zh: 我在沙下拱起一道土脊。
lines.en: I raise a ridge of earth beneath the sand.
My head points your way.
Above me, the soil is cracking.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得沙粒直跳。
lines.en: Your steps make the sand grains jump.
Just keep standing.
One breath more. Make no sound.
The soil broke. I'm up.
Don't stop. Charge.
That impact throws the dirt up.
I land and burrow back down.

lines.zh: 我拱开沙层，整条身子撞过去。
lines.en: I breach the sand and slam my whole body into you.
My body hits your legs.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也翻倒了。
lines.en: That knocked me over too.
I raise my head and ram again.
My teeth aren't hard yet.
Ramming is all I have.
After the hit I burrow down.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，我已经进去了。
lines.en: You stomp. I'm already under.
Under the soil you won't find me.

lines.zh: 我从你背后破土，撞你小腿。
lines.en: I break ground behind you and hit your calf.
Looking back won't help.
This one takes your ankle.
Not much strength. But quick.
One more and I withdraw.
I push up out of the soil.
Sand rolls off my back.
I'm only a block tall.
This soil suits me.
I'm still growing. Far from grown.
A long way from grown.
First, let me learn this ground.

lines.zh: 哪里有沙，哪里有土，我都记下。
lines.en: Where there's sand, where there's soil. I note it.
Vibration from above.

lines.zh: 沙面塌了一块，我钻了进去。
lines.en: A patch of sand collapses; I burrow in.
Until it moves further off.
When it's far, come out again.
This soil is mine.

lines.zh: 上面那些东西，只是路过。
lines.en: What walks above is only passing.

lines.zh: 我有两个多小时，我不急。
lines.en: I've hours yet. I'm in no hurry.
I've a couple of hours yet.
The soil baked hard. I can't move.

lines.zh: 我从土里翻出去，摔在地上。
lines.en: I rolled out of the soil and hit the ground.
Water filled the soil and I choked.
The blast shook the soil loose.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过土层，钉在我身上。
lines.en: Something came through the soil into me.

lines.zh: 那光透过土，我整个僵住。
lines.en: That light came through the soil and I froze.

lines.zh: 土里找不到活的，我越来越弱。
lines.en: Nothing living in the soil. I grow weak.
Lightning hit the soil and I convulsed.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我钻不进去。
lines.en: No soil here. I can't burrow.
